-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.SnapConf` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

theorem cfgFold_good {dec : CCDec} {c0 s : CCState} {l : List EntryM} (h : CCGood c0) (H : cfgFold
    dec c0 l = some s) : CCGood s

def SnapConfOk (dec : CCDec) (c0 : CCState) (pre : List EntryM) (vo v l ln : List w64) (al : Bool) :
    Prop :=
  CSWf vo v l ln ∧ ∃ s, cfgFold dec c0 pre = some s ∧ csCfgM vo v l ln al = s.cfg

theorem cfgFoldFrom_good {dec : CCDec} {pre : List EntryM} {s s' : CCState} {l : List EntryM} (h :
    CCGood s) (H : cfgFoldFrom dec pre s l = some s') : CCGood s'

theorem cfgStateC_of_good {s : CCState} (h : CCGood s) : cfgStateC s.cfg = s
